source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 大规模涨价 手机快买不起了
topics.official_english: Smartphone prices surge sharply, raising affordability concerns
topics.why_hot: The topic has sparked widespread discussion about how fast-rising handset prices are affecting consumer purchasing power.
topics.share_angle: Explain the trend of rising smartphone prices and what it means for the average consumer and the broader market.

topics.why_hot: Severe rainstorms in Henan have raised public concerns over flooding, emergencies, and safety.
topics.share_angle: Cover the scale of the rainstorm and the emergency response, while providing context on the region's flood risks.

topics.official_english: Magnitude 7.7 earthquake off Indonesia triggers tsunami
topics.why_hot: A powerful earthquake in Indonesia has triggered tsunami warnings, drawing global attention to the disaster and its potential impact.
topics.share_angle: Summarize the quake and tsunami warning, and explain the science behind tsunamis and Indonesia's location on the Pacific Ring of Fire.

topics.official_english: Gold, silver and oil prices all climb
topics.why_hot: A coordinated rise in commodity prices has caught investors' attention amid global economic uncertainty.
topics.share_angle: Break down the factors behind rising gold, silver and oil prices, and what they signal for the global economy.

topics.chinese_topic: 这些一次性塑料制品禁用
topics.official_english: New restrictions announced on single-use plastic products
topics.why_hot: The government's ban on certain single-use plastics has become a trending topic due to its direct impact on daily life and the environment.
topics.share_angle: Explain which products are affected, how the policy fits into broader environmental goals, and what alternatives consumers have.

topics.chinese_topic: “床车旅行”从小众到潮流 酒店慌了
topics.official_english: Car-bed travel turns from niche to trend, worrying hotels
topics.why_hot: A growing number of travelers are turning their cars into temporary beds, creating a new accommodation trend that challenges the hotel industry.
topics.share_angle: Profile the car-bed travel movement, its appeal for budget travelers, and how hotels are responding to the shift.

topics.chinese_topic: 对双胞胎考上同一所大学
topics.official_english: Twin siblings admitted to the same university
topics.why_hot: The heartwarming story of twins gaining admission to the same university has resonated during the college application season.
topics.share_angle: Share the twins' story and discuss the role of family support in educational success.

topics.chinese_topic: 暴雨洪涝过后 喝水千万别大意
topics.official_english: Don't take drinking water safety lightly after floods
topics.why_hot: Heavy rains and flooding have raised health concerns about contaminated water, making safety reminders a trending topic.
topics.share_angle: Provide practical advice on water safety and disease prevention after floods, useful for people in affected areas.
